The story behind Rizen

The name brings together two simple ideas: riz, the French word for rice, and risen, a nod to the Northeast, where the sun first rises over India. RIZEN is a collection of eight rice wines, each inspired by the traditions, landscapes, and flavours of a different Northeastern state.

The Meghalaya Edition

A Meghalaya-style rice wine, locally brewed in Delhi.

Known as the Abode of Clouds, Meghalaya is a land of misty hills, living root bridges, sacred forests, and warm community hospitality. BBC Travel named Meghalaya among the world’s 20 best places to travel in 2027, the only Indian destination on the list.
